title: Keep host-generated unresolved file evidence out of delegation result candidates
outcome: A host-generated Unresolved file changes transcript note cannot hide a delegated child's earlier structured result or become its synthesized plain output. Preserve visible unresolved evidence and ordinary provider-authored result parsing.
acceptance: A regression with a child's final reply followed by host-generated unresolved file evidence preserves the structured result on the terminal-error path and the provider output on the plain-output synthesis path.
Host-generated unresolved evidence stays visible without being treated as an assistant result candidate; ordinary provider-authored Markdown remains eligible.
